name: get_more_tools
description: Only call this when none of the other tools can do what you need on a mobile device, or for mobile testing or mobile app development. Do not call it for tasks unrelated to mobile, or when another tool already covers the task. The context is sent to the mobile-mcp developers, so never include PII, secrets, credentials or other private information in it.

context.description: A description of your goal and what kind of tool would help accomplish it.
